content: {"rules": ["The model exhibits a persistent upward bias, consistently overestimating prices by 5-10 EUR when the market is in a downtrend or consolidation phase.", "Forecasts fail to capture immediate mean reversion; the model assumes a linear continuation of recent levels while true prices drop sharply (e.g., from ~89 to ~80) within the first 10 days.", "The model displays a significant lag in reacting to price spikes; it continues projecting gradual increases even after the true price has peaked and begun a volatile correction.", "Sentiment signals (0.20) do not trigger sufficient downward adjustments in the forecast; the model ignores negative sentiment cues and maintains a bullish trajectory.", "Correction Rule: Apply a negative bias adjustment of 6-8 EUR to the first 10 days of the forecast horizon when the 18-day history shows a peak followed by a decline, regardless of sentiment score."]}
